notes.title: Massive Update v0.9-New Character Added
notes.notes:
Here comes the Big Update !!
This update mainly includes:

1. Additional role Dancer Jean!!
Character Special:

11 ring-Slots
At the beginning of each battle all rings will be randomly switched.
(Adjust and fighting at the same time according to the random switched situation in every battle! The fingers with 3 ring-wearable slots appear for the first time!!)


2. Add new role Ring Warlock Pantheon!!!
Character Special:

Fingers with HP rank will get a corresponding effect:
All fingers with the 1st high HP: TANK rings will automatically release
All fingers with the 2nd high HP: SPIRIT rings will automatically release
All fingers with the 3th high HP: SKILL rings will automatically release

Challenge doubled!! Ring switching became the new battle cores?


3. Other insignificant optimizations compared to those new characters above : )


Hope you guys have fun with them~

notes.title: Content update V0.8.3
notes.notes:
1. Monsterpedia: now you can click on the bag to see the monsterpedia.
2. Added warning for rounds over 25.
3. Adjust dungeon generation rules: each special event occurs more equally.
4. Adjust the monster generation rules: the same monster will not appear continuously.
5. The Boss starts dropping advanced rings.
6. Add Material ring: make a reinforcement between "A ring" and a Material ring will definitely obtain "A ring+".
7. Multiple bugs fixed.

notes.title: Bug fix V0.8.1
notes.notes:
1. Crush bug in fighting Wentini fixed
2. Crush bug in fighting Black Flash fixed
3. Chance to Nullify an attack by Frozen is become more orderly
4. Fix bug: enemy cannot attack when Cushion and an attack are used in the same round.
5. Fix bug: sounds of a multi-target attack
6. Crush bug after s/l multiple times is fixed.

notes.title: bug fix V0.8
notes.notes:
1. We accelerate animations of all attack moves. 
2. We add an extra slot to the battle bag, which in total is 4 slots.
3. Add a clear hint in the scene after defeating a Boss.  
4. Fixed some crush bugs.

Thanks for all your comments and support, we will fix bugs and any bad game expression comes now and in the future continuously.
